clauses.label: Valuation approaches
clauses.summary: Market, income and cost approaches to value.

clauses.label: Income approach and DCF
clauses.summary: Income approach converts projected cash flows to present value; methods are DCF variations.

clauses.label: Matrix pricing
clauses.summary: A comparable-transactions subset that infers a security's yield from benchmark quoted securities.

clauses.label: Valuation models
clauses.summary: A valuation model must be fit for purpose; characteristics of appropriate models.

clauses.label: Intangible asset methods
clauses.summary: Income-approach methods for intangibles: excess earnings (MPEEM) and relief-from-royalty.

clauses.label: Valuation techniques
clauses.summary: Use appropriate techniques, maximising observable inputs.

clauses.label: Three valuation techniques
clauses.summary: Market approach, cost approach and income approach.

clauses.label: Blockage factors
clauses.summary: Premiums/discounts inconsistent with the unit of account (incl. a blockage factor) are not permitted.

clauses.label: Lease liability measurement
clauses.summary: Present value of lease payments at the interest rate implicit in the lease or the incremental borrowing rate.

clauses.label: Value in use
clauses.summary: Present value of the future cash flows expected from an asset or cash-generating unit.

clauses.label: Pre-tax discount rate
clauses.summary: The discount rate shall be a pre-tax rate reflecting current market assessments of the time value of money and asset-specific risks.

clauses.label: Recoverable amount
clauses.summary: Recoverable amount is the higher of fair value less costs of disposal and value in use.

divergences.ifrs_basis: IAS 36.55 pre-tax rate consistent with value-in-use

divergences.ivs_basis: IVS 210.60.20 royalty rate from comparable licences or a profit split
divergences.ifrs_basis: IFRS 13.62 income approach; market-participant royalty in the asset's highest and best use

divergences.ivs_basis: IVS 210.60.16 contributory asset charges at economic rent
divergences.ifrs_basis: IFRS 13.62 income approach; charges from the market participant's perspective

divergences.ivs_basis: IVS 103 basis of value and premise (e.g. market value)
divergences.ifrs_basis: IAS 36.18 recoverable amount = higher of FVLCD and value in use (entity-specific)

divergences.ivs_basis: IVS 103/105 probability-weighted inputs for a market-participant value

divergences.ifrs_basis: IFRS 13 input hierarchy (Level 2 observable inputs where quoted prices are unavailable)
